transcript: For the next seven days, watch what leaves your mouth. Do not speak negatively about yourself. Do not speak negatively about others. Just one week, each day, your mind produces tens of thousands of thoughts. Most of them are not new. They are echoes from yesterday and the day before that. When you repeat the same thoughts, you repeat the same life. But when you interrupt the pattern, even briefly, the mind begins to soften. The nervous system begins to relax. New pathways begin to form. One week without feeding negativity is enough to start changing the direction of your mind. So when a negative thought appears, do not fight it. Do not judge it. Simply let it pass and choose silence instead. This is the practice. Seven days. And if you feel ready to go deeper to continue this work with guidance, structure, and daily grounding practices, the 30-day healing journey is waiting for you. You'll find it in the link on my profile.
